root_cause: Powerhouse already contained strong sales, persuasion, brand-voice, objection and follow-up knowledge, but runtime actions could still reach execution with generic templates or weak personalization because message strategy and copy quality were not a mandatory canonical gate.
decision: Promote the existing commercial knowledge into one canonical message plan, persuasion authority, human composer and fail-closed quality gate before Gmail or SalesRobot execution.
prevention: every external commercial action receives an explicit message strategy and ethical psychology contract
specific public/inbound context is required for personalization; role or company name alone is insufficient
generic praise, generic outreach openings, unsupported generalizations, fake urgency and reply guilt are blocked
Gmail and SalesRobot require composer v2 quality proof before execution
message strategy and persuasion labels remain attached to actions so outcomes and revenue can train strategy performance
composer processing is bounded and scheduled every fifteen minutes
